matches.why: Proves the symmetric (and nonsymmetric) Mahler volume-product conjectures in every dimension with Hanner polytope equality cases.
Proves bounded-distortion L_1 embeddings for planar and bounded-treewidth graph metrics, the planar and treewidth cases of the GNRS conjecture.
Proves the Brauchart–Hardin–Saff conjecture on the linear term of optimal logarithmic energy on the 2-sphere, a Thomson-type minimal energy question.
Proves planar Cohn–Elkies sharpness, with the Fourier certificate attaining the optimal circle-packing density in dimension 2.
